reported_success.quote: The finding that participants said they knew another person better if they were given information about them replicated in both the entire sample and the sample of those who passed the manipulation check

notes: Replication Table 1 also prints Welch t(464.53) = 8.381, d = 0.769, p < 0.001. The extracted d = 0.770 and t = 8.387 consistently select Student’s test, matching the original full-sample Student’s test.
